lines.name: l1
lines.text: [whispers] Shift twenty. Patient thirteen passed every check.

lines.name: l2
lines.text: [whispers] Temperature, normal. Pulse, normal. He just... never blinked.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: [whispers] I put him in the waiting room. Camera five. He sat there for two hours, facing the camera. Not the door.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: [whispers] At three nineteen, camera three lost him.

lines.name: l5
lines.text: [whispers] The only thing left in the hallway was one of his slippers.

lines.name: l6
lines.text: [whispers] Camera eight is the security room.

lines.name: l7
lines.text: [whispers] I'm the only one in it.
